why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Check that you're allowed. XO blocks places "such as the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Singapore, Ontario (Canada), as well as any jurisdiction where the use of XO would be unlawful." You must be 18 or older, and "Do not use VPNs, proxies, Tor, or any other method to disguise your location or identity".
Sign in at beta.xo.market with email, a social login or your own wallet. XO explains: "Your owner or embedded wallet proves control; the XO smart wallet holds your trading USDC".

Fund the smart wallet. You can "Connect an external EVM or Solana wallet and select a supported asset." Note that "Depositing into your external owner wallet does not make the XO smart wallet tradable."
Spend your points on Parlays when one is open. Withdraw USDC from the account menu.
